# Explore-Share

> > Explore-Share connects adventure seekers with certified mountain guides (IFMGA, UIMLA) for guided climbing, skiing, and trekking experiences worldwide.

The platform specializes in backcountry skiing, ski touring, rock climbing, and mountaineering expeditions across the Alps, Andes, and other mountain ranges. Explore-Share features both multi-day guided trips and educational blog content covering destinations, techniques, and guide certifications.

## Key Topics

- IFMGA certified mountain guides
- UIMLA guide certification
- Backcountry skiing and ski touring
- Off-piste and freeride skiing
- Rock climbing and ice climbing
- Heliskiing adventures
- Alps (Austria, Italy, France)
- Andes mountains
- Aosta Valley
- Mountain safety and equipment
- Family-friendly mountain activities
- Patagonia trekking
- Nepal mountaineering
- European ski destinations
- Beginner guides and tutorials

## Guided Adventures & Trips

- [Full day traverse to Frey Hut with a guide. 1-day trip. UIMLA guide](https://www.explore-share.com/trip/frey-mountain-hut-traverse-bariloche): Full-day Patagonia trek to Frey Hut with AAGM guide Juan Carlos
- [Ski Touring in Finnmark: 8-day Guided Arctic Adventure. IFMGA guide](https://www.explore-share.com/trip/guided-ski-tour-finnmark-norway): 8-day IFMGA-guided Arctic ski touring expedition in Finnmark, Norway

## Ski Touring & Backcountry Skiing

- [Backcountry Skiing in Stowe, Vermont: All You Need to Know](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/backcountry-skiing-in-stowe-vermont-all-you-need-to-know): Backcountry skiing guide to Stowe's Green Mountains and Mt. Mansfield
- [Ski Touring in Courmayeur: What are the Best Spots?](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/ski-touring-in-courmayeur-what-are-the-best-spots): Best ski touring spots in Courmayeur at Mont Blanc's base, Aosta Valley
- [Best Freeride and Ski Touring Spots in Russia](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/best-freeride-and-ski-touring-spots-in-russia): Russia's top ski touring spots: Elbrus, Caucasus, and Siberian volcanoes
- [Ski touring in the Pyrenees: an adventure for the whole family](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/ski-touring-in-the-pyrenees-an-adventure-for-the-whole-family): Family ski touring in Val d'Aran, Pyrenees with guide Roger Martorell
- [Ski Touring in Greece? The Tale of an Unforgettable Adventure!](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/Ski-touring-Greece-tale-unforgettable-adventure): Dimitri's ski touring adventure on Mount Olympus with local guide Babis
- [Best Things to Do in Innsbruck, Austria](https://www.explore-share.com/blog/best-things-to-do-innsbruck-austria): Innsbruck outdoor activities guide: ski touring, climbing in the Alps
